scope: Five compact Air Operations equipment schedules on M-603 (source PDF page 44): air-cooled chillers, fans, air separators, expansion tanks and dehumidifiers. The grille/register/diffuser and fan sound-power tables remain in separate unfinished scope.
coordinate_system: Displayed PDF page, points, top-left origin; 2448 x 1584.

visual_review.finding: The named compact tables were visually reviewed at 180 DPI. Their rows, blank cells, multi-level headers and schedule notes were separately transcribed and corroborated from both native-text captures.

tables.title: AIR COOLED CHILLER SCHEDULE
notes: 1. PROVIDE SINGLE POINT OF CONNECTION FOR CHILLER. PROVIDE DISCONNECT SWITCH, NEMA-4X STAINLESS STEEL.
2. PROVIDE FACTORY APPLIED COIL CORROSION PROTECTION COATING TO MEET ASTM B117 3000 HR. CAPACITY INDICATED WITH COATING ON COIL.
3. UNIT SHALL HAVE FULL CAPACITY AT 98°F AMBIENT AND SHALL PROVIDE FULL COOLING DOWN TO 24°F.
4. CHILLER SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH QUICK RESTART. CHILLER SHALL BE CAPABLE OF BEING AT 100% LOAD WITHIN 5 MINUTES OF RESTORATION OF POWER.
